code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, lymphopenia, neutropenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and monocytosis with elevated basophils. There is also mild hypochloremic metabolic acidosis (low CO₂), and a slight increase in total bilirubin. Red cell indices and renal/liver function are otherwise within normal limits. Findings suggest possible infection or inflammatory process with impaired oxygenation; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
